name: quietpair
description: A pair-programming companion that watches, suggests, and lets you lead

vsAgent.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://api.openai.com/v1)

vsAgent.model.description: Model name to use for chat completions (e.g. deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner)

vsAgent.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key in plaintext. NOT recommended: settings are stored in plain text and synced by Settings Sync. Prefer [QuietPair: Set API Key](command:vs-agent.setApiKey), which stores the key in encrypted SecretStorage. If both are set, SecretStorage wins.

enumDescriptions: Discuss only: the agent reads and analyzes but write_file / run_command / update_memory are refused outright (no prompts)
Ask first: every write operation pops an Approve/Reject dialog in the chat panel
Pre-authorize: write operations are auto-approved (each one is logged to the transcript; use only in trusted workspaces)
vsAgent.permissionMode.description: Permission level for agent write operations. The partner defaults to advising; acting is the exception and requires your say-so.

vsAgent.companion.enabled.description: Enable the companion mode: automatically analyze the code you are editing and push suggestions

vsAgent.autoRunReadonlyCommands.description: Run allowlisted read-only shell commands without asking for approval (ls, cat, grep, git log/status/diff, etc.; pipelines and && chains allowed when every segment is allowlisted; no redirects/substitutions; paths must stay inside the workspace). Everything else still prompts.

vsAgent.companion.debounceSeconds.description: Seconds of idle time after ordinary typing before the companion analyzes the current file

vsAgent.companion.quickTriggerSeconds.description: Seconds of idle time before analysis after semantic trigger edits (statement end, paste, deletion, blank line)

vsAgent.companion.cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two LLM analyses. Triggers during cooldown are deferred, not dropped

vsAgent.companion.saveTriage.description: On file save, run a lightweight triage call to decide whether to wake the deep analysis (layer-2 observer)

vsAgent.triageModel.description: Optional cheaper model for save-time triage (e.g. a flash/lite model). Empty = use vsAgent.model

vsAgent.responseLanguage.description: Language of the model's user-facing output (chat replies, suggestion titles and details). The panel UI itself is English.

vsAgent.learningMode.description: Learning mode: the chat agent guides you with questions instead of handing over answers (brief explanations allowed for conceptual confusion; it still defers when you ask directly or stay stuck)
